Signature help shows unqualified enum default argument values.

-- flags --
-ignore_extra_diags

-- args.go --
package fork

enum Mode {
	Read
	Write
}

func open(path string, mode Mode = Read) Mode {
	return mode
}

func _() {
	open("x") //@signature("(", "open(path string, mode Mode = Read) Mode", -1)
}
